caption: Day 2 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Classic Spaghetti & Meatballs 🍝 Ingredients Meatballs • 13 oz ground beef • ¼ cup breadcrumbs • 1 egg • 2 tbsp parsley • ½ tsp oregano • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt (1 year+) & pepper Sauce • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 shallot • 3 garlic cloves • 1½–2 cups passata • ½ tsp oregano Pasta • 8 oz spaghetti Directions Mix and shape the meatballs → brown them → make the sauce → simmer the meatballs → cook the spaghetti → toss everything together and serve ✨ One family dinner, one meal for everyone 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #spaghettiandmeatballs #toddlermeals #whatmytoddlereats#toddlermealspes
